description: Exact image sizes for Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Discord, Twitch, Pinterest, marketplaces and passport photos, with safe zones (pixel areas the app covers or crops), upload limits and minimum sizes. Free, no API key. With no arguments it lists every size id; pass `id` (e.g. "youtube-banner/banner") or `platform` (e.g. "Instagram") for full details.

id.description: A size id like "instagram-story/story", or a group id like "youtube-banner".

name: get_image_sizes
title: Image sizes for social media and passports
